name: Captain Livé’s desk
role: Scene 1 — Captain Livé’s quarters; replacement for the desk blockout

source.model_identifier: Not exposed by the built-in image generation tool

references.role: Previous desk design; dressing, teal finish and perspective cameras replaced

generation_history.prompt:
Redo the attached captain's desk as ONE clean production modeling turnaround sheet. The first reference supplies the desk DESIGN ONLY; its teal color, tabletop objects, perspective cameras, visible top planes, and inconsistent scale are all mistakes to replace. The second reference supplies the cartoony sculpted game-art rendering style, not a character to draw.

OUTPUT: one wide horizontal strip containing exactly FOUR distinct whole-desk views, in left-to-right order FRONT, LEFT SIDE, RIGHT SIDE, BACK. No written labels. Pure flat opaque white RGB 255,255,255 background, no gradient, cast shadow, ground plane, border, dimensions or annotations. Four separate equal-size framing cells, each centered. Wide clear empty vertical bands separate every desk. Entire desk and all feet visible.

CRITICAL CAMERA CONSTRUCTION: these are true ORTHOGRAPHIC TECHNICAL ELEVATIONS, perfectly straight-on, with the optical axis HORIZONTAL, zero camera pitch and zero roll. Camera is level with the desk's mid-height. Rotate the SAME unchanged object about its vertical axis by exactly 0, 90, 270, 180 degrees. No perspective, no three-quarter views, no view from above. In front and back there is NO visible tabletop upper plane and NO visible outside side panel. In the two side elevations there is NO visible drawer front and NO visible rear panel: only the outside side panel. Every horizontal structural edge is horizontal and parallel. Every vertical structural edge is vertical and parallel. The tabletop reads as a horizontal thick edge, not a trapezoid or diamond. Do NOT tilt the camera to show the top.

EXACT COMMON SCALE: outer desk dimensions width 1.8 m, height 0.76 m, depth 0.9 m. Front and back silhouettes have equal widths and equal heights, width divided by height 2.3684. Both side silhouettes have equal widths and equal heights, width divided by height 1.1842. Each side view is exactly HALF the width of the front view. ALL FOUR silhouettes are EXACTLY THE SAME HEIGHT, measured from the topmost tabletop edge to the bottoms of the brass feet. Place all four tabletop edges on the SAME horizontal level, and all feet on the SAME invisible ground baseline. Do not fit a narrow side view larger in its cell. All four cameras use one fixed orthographic scale.

DESK DESIGN TO RETAIN: the reference's low, broad light honey-brown wooden plank tabletop, two boxy drawer pedestals with exactly THREE drawers in each on the working FRONT, six chunky rectangular brass drawer pulls total, broad white-background knee opening between the pedestals. Four stout square corner legs, brass top corner guards, brass foot caps, chunky rectangular side panel with a broad slightly crooked wooden repair board secured by two large brass nails. Both outside side panels have this repair treatment, with appropriate opposite-facing orientation. At the BACK show the plain wood backs of the two pedestals and the same central white knee opening, absolutely NO drawers or handles at the back. The front and rear are clearly different faces of the same desk. Preserve these construction proportions and the brass fittings' shapes.

CHANGES: make ALL of the former teal/green carcass DARK STAINED MAHOGANY / WALNUT, a deep warm reddish brown with lighter warm brown exposed wood at worn edges and chunky chips in the stained finish. NO teal, green, blue or cool paint. Keep the tabletop lighter honey-brown; keep the yellow-gold brass corners, square feet and rectangular pulls exactly that style. Make the tabletop COMPLETELY BARE. No charts, maps, rolled paper, inkwell, compass, bowl, pen, leather pad or other accessory anywhere in any view. This sheet is the desk object alone.

RENDERING: stylized cartoony pirate adventure game prop to sit beside Captain Livé in the second reference. Chunky softened bevels and exaggerated robust hardware, saturated but dirty warm browns, broad hand-shaped wear. Soft restrained sculpted shading and readable simple color masses, no photorealism, no fine noisy grain, no etched linework or tiny decoration. Consistent neutral studio form lighting across all four elevations. Prioritize true orthographic projection, identical measured height and a correct rear elevation over showing any extra surfaces. Maximum native resolution, very wide four-panel single row.

Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit this desk modeling sheet with one proportional correction, retaining its excellent level front/left/right/back elevations, all colors, exact same design, six front brass pulls, brass corners/feet, wear, repaired side panels and bare top.

The desk's physical dimensions are 1.8 m wide, 0.76 m high and 0.9 m deep. In the current source the four silhouettes are all 285 pixels tall, and their widths are about 629 / 314 / 317 / 628 pixels. This is slightly too tall. Keep the front and rear widths approximately 629 px, and make ALL FOUR desks 266 px tall. The side widths must both be approximately 314–315 px. Thus front/back width divided by height is 2.368 and side width divided by height is 1.184. Apply the SAME small vertical proportion change to ALL FOUR views. This is a 7% reduction in object height, with width unchanged. Keep all four bottoms at the same existing ground baseline; all four top edges also on one common horizontal line. Do not independently enlarge any view. Identical object height in all four views is mandatory.

Preserve strict orthographic projection: horizontal optical axis, camera at desk middle, zero pitch, roll or perspective. No broad tabletop upper plane visible; only its thick narrow edge and rounded bevel. Front drawer elevations only in view1, left outside panel only in view2, right outside panel only in view3, plain rear pedestals without handles in view4. Keep exactly the same white central knee openings. The desktop is completely bare in all views. Deep warm walnut/mahogany carcass, light honey plank top, warm brass fittings; no teal.

Keep one row of four separated full objects, no text, labels, arrows, drawn lines or extra objects. Pure flat white opaque background with no paper grain, noise, gradients or cast shadow. Keep the existing soft cartoony sculpted game-art treatment. Do not redesign anything; correct only the specified common height/proportion and clean flat white background.

assembly.method: Unchanged repository cutter; crops and translates all views onto equal 779 px square canvases with one baseline. Native crop size equals output size; no resampling or independent view scaling.

pipeline.lighting_note: Soft consistent form shading is baked into the source. Use the lighting-removal option described in ART_SPEC.md during reconstruction to avoid adding room lighting twice.
pipeline.validation_scope: 2D elevations, source scale consistency, pixel bounds and cutter compatibility checked. Tripo reconstruction and engine import have not been run.

dimensions_m.note: Engine target dimensions for the complete bare desk. Height is ground to tabletop top; there are no accessory meshes in this asset.

placement.convention_status: Proposed mesh convention; no engine placement code changed.

fishbowl.clearance: The entire tabletop is bare. The fishbowl remains a separate engine object.

design.structure: Light plank top over two dark warm wood drawer pedestals, three drawers per pedestal at the front, four square corner legs, an open central knee space, brass corner guards and feet.
design.back: Plain pedestal backs with no drawer pulls; central knee opening remains visible.
design.sides: Both outside pedestal panels have a broad wooden repair board fixed with two chunky brass nails.
design.finish: Deep warm walnut/mahogany stained carcass, honey-brown plank top, broad lighter exposed wood chips and worn edges, retained yellow-gold brass fittings.

framing.camera: Level at object mid-height, horizontal optical axis, zero pitch and roll; front and back are face-on, sides are end-on. Rounded bevels remain visible.
framing.background: Plain visually white, opaque; slight generated 1–2 level background variation is below the cutter threshold. No scenery, labels, borders, floor plane or cast shadows.
framing.scale: Same generated scale across the four elevations; source and final heights agree within 1 px. Engine dimensions in dimensions_m are authoritative.
framing.holes: White background visible through the central knee opening in front and back.

validation.method: Visual review plus unchanged repository cutter and foreground pixel bounds
validation.foreground_threshold: Sum of RGB channel distances from the modal background greater than 54 (cutter tolerance 18)
validation.visual_review: Bare object, warm dark wood, brass fittings, three front drawers per pedestal, distinct plain rear, repaired side elevations, level orthographic construction and open knee space checked. The sheet is ready for a first Tripo reconstruction trial; mesh quality has not been assessed.
